feeds.title: MotorcylcleDaily
feeds.description: MotorcycleDaily is an online magazine that features everything related to motorcycles. Keep up to date with all the latest motorcycle news, editorials, bike reviews, and insights right here at MotorcycleDaily.com.

feeds.title: THE PACK
feeds.description: THE PACK is an Electric Motorcycle News website has been launched in March 2017 and is a personal initiative from Guy Salens to inform and inspire you about electric motorcycles, electric scooters, and some other light electric vehicles.

feeds.title: Women Riders Now
feeds.description: WomenRidersNow.com is a news and information resource for and about women and motorcycling. The mission is to educate and inform the motorcycle industry and general public on the fastest growing demographic in motorcycling, women, through our news, reviews, and feature stories.

feeds.title: Motorcycle Sports
feeds.description: Motorcycle Sports brings you the best of the wheeled world, giving you the latest news on your favorite races, and direct access to our best content.

feeds.title: BikeSport News » MotoGP
feeds.description: Bikesport News gives you the latest news, results, qualifying information, pictures, and more across MotoGP, WSBK, BSB, and TT Road Racing. Bikesportnews is one of the UK's biggest bike-racing websites and the destination for more than half a million visitors every month, as well as the place for riders, team managers, promoters, and those in the industry to find out who is doing what to whom and who doesn't want anyone to find out about it.

feeds.title: MoreBikes
feeds.description: MoreBikes is the one-stop shop for all your motorcycling needs. Whether you're into the latest superbikes, the greatest tourers, the naughtiest nakeds, or the scootiest scooters - if you're a brand new person to the world of motorcycling or you've been riding a lifetime - we're exactly what you need for your two-wheeled life.

feeds.title: RideApart
feeds.description: Keep up with the latest news, bike & gear reviews, expert advice, how-to guides, history, and great lists. RideApart helps motorcyclists stay up-to-date with informative & engaging content on the motorcycle and Powersports industry.

feeds.title: Superbike News » Motogp
feeds.description: Superbike News features the latest news, and images from the main Motorcycle Racing series around the world and also the latest Motorcycle Industry news from the main bike manufacturers and apparel, etc. Established in March 2001. Our goal is to keep you updated about all the racing events that take place across the world.

feeds.title: Insane Throttle Biker News
feeds.description: The Insane Throttle Biker News website since 2011-covering up to minute biker news including Outlaw motorcycle clubs & biker news worldwide.Find all the up-to-date news and issues that face the biker lifestyle as a whole.

feeds.title: MCNews
feeds.description: MCNews is an online resource for Australian motorcycle enthusiasts. It brings you all the latest motorcycle news including the latest bikes, race results, and motorcycle reviews.

feeds.title: Ultimate Motorcycling
feeds.description: Welcome to Ultimate Motorcycling, which features the latest news surrounding the motorcycle industry. Ultimate Motorcycling features everything from the latest motorcycle and apparel reviews to MotoGP results to which OEM is topping the sales. Our passionate staff work around the clock to deliver the latest and most accurate reports in regard to everything in the two-wheel world.

feeds.title: Motorbike Writer
feeds.description: Motorbike Writer is a motorcycle industry publisher that provides a global audience with motorcycle industry news, reviews, and topical motorcycling commentary written by Mark Hinchliffe.

feeds.title: All Electric Motorcycle
feeds.description: At All Electric Motorcycle, we are a dedicated team of motorcycle enthusiasts, who bring you the latest Electric Motorcycle trend, news, reviews, and updates. Find coverage of worldwide fastest and upcoming Electric motorcycles.

feeds.title: Motorcycle.com
feeds.description: Since 1994, Motorcycle.com has been the definitive information resource for motorcycle enthusiasts around the world. Motorcycle.com presents an unrivaled combination of bike reviews and news written by industry experts, boasting first-rate photography and videos to deliver entertaining motorcycle information.

feeds.title: Cycle World
feeds.description: Cycle World is the most trusted source for motorcycle information available. Check out their blog which features motorcycle reviews, and provides the latest information on motorcycle gear, videos, news, and so much more.

feeds.title: Motorcyclist
feeds.description: The motorcyclist is America's First motorcycle magazine which features everything from new motorcycle reviews to motorcycle maintenance tips to our exclusive motorcycle buyers' guide.
